a.description: hold-out (a) on its eight molecules never trained on in any version (the set fixed on 30 Oct 2026): eight layer-A molecules held out on 19 Sep 2026; this version's training left out the twins of the hold-out molecules, so the other two, 2-naphthoic acid and benzonitrile, are clean too, and the eight are kept for comparability with v1.3

quantities.readouts: first-order diagonal error of each seed's correction, averaged over the seeds
quantities.product: error of the corrected band positions of the seed-mean correction

accuracy.target_source: 3 cm⁻¹ per family — decision 53's line for ring-ip, CH-oop and 'other', every family's under decision 65 (the licence) — and the coupling ratio ≤ 0.25 of chain 35's T1 line (probes/chain35_read.py)

definitions.family: rms over the family's B3LYP modes of the first-order diagonal error of a seed's ΔH against the higher level, per seed, and the seeds' mean (cm⁻¹); families by module 05's rule (m05/learning_curve_layerA.molecule_features)
definitions.product: rms over the family's bands of the corrected band position's error against the higher level (cm⁻¹): the seeds' mean ΔH added to the B3LYP Hessian and diagonalised, each corrected band paired to its higher-level band by mode overlap and counted in the family of its B3LYP partner — what the pipeline prints; with the 95 % interval of a bootstrap over whole molecules
definitions.coupling_ratio: rms of the predicted mode couplings' error over the rms of the couplings themselves; 0 = exact, 1 = no better than none
definitions.spectrum_overlap: cosine similarity of the two Lorentzian-broadened spectra (FWHM 10 cm⁻¹, 500–3500 cm⁻¹); 1 = identical shape
definitions.intensity_error: intensity-weighted rms of the relative height error per band, bands paired by the shape of the motion (eigenvector overlap); 0 = identical heights

accuracy.coupled_cluster: not measured for this network version: the coupled-cluster reads (T3) were made on an earlier network (chain 34)

licence.statement: licensed at the DFT proxy: ring-ip (1.17 / 1.22), CH-stretch (0.8 / 1.67), CH-oop (1.86 / 1.26), other (2.38 / 2.1); not licensed: none — error of the corrected band positions of the seed-mean correction on hold-outs (a) / (b) in cm⁻¹ against 3 (decision 65 as amended on 16 Nov 2026); CH-oop on hold-out (a) rests on 5 of the hold-out's 8 molecules (the others have no such band): the 95 % interval of a bootstrap over molecules is 0.93–3.2 cm⁻¹ and crosses the line (96 % of the resamples lie under it); other on hold-out (a) rests on 8 molecules: the 95 % interval of a bootstrap over molecules is 1.45–3.19 cm⁻¹ and crosses the line (93 % of the resamples lie under it); the first-order diagonal error of each seed's correction, averaged over the seeds, which the licence read until then: ring-ip (1.55 / 1.64), CH-stretch (1.15 / 2.02), CH-oop (2.22 / 1.72), other (2.91 / 3.68); no coupled-cluster licence
licence.rule_source: README.md, decision 65 as amended on 16 Nov 2026
licence.quantity_name: error of the corrected band positions of the seed-mean correction
caveats: CH-oop on hold-out (a) rests on 5 of the hold-out's 8 molecules (the others have no such band): the 95 % interval of a bootstrap over molecules is 0.93–3.2 cm⁻¹ and crosses the line (96 % of the resamples lie under it)
other on hold-out (a) rests on 8 molecules: the 95 % interval of a bootstrap over molecules is 1.45–3.19 cm⁻¹ and crosses the line (93 % of the resamples lie under it)

withheld.note: the molecule has a linear group, and molecules with one moved by up to 11.20 cm⁻¹ under a rotation, a mirror image or another xyz listing, more than the licence line
withheld.reason: the molecule has a linear group (an angle near 180°, as in a nitrile or an alkyne), and the measured spread under a rotation, a mirror image or another xyz listing of the atoms for molecules with one (11.20 cm⁻¹, from the release's invariance record) exceeds the licence line of 3 cm⁻¹, so the network's correction for this molecule is not licensed; the corrected positions are still printed

licence.concerns: the licence (decision 65) is on the harmonic position ω against the DFT proxy (ωB97X); it says nothing about the anharmonic position ν

positions.note: each band is printed at its best estimate — the anharmonic position ν = ω + Δ_anh for 27 of 33 bands (Δ_anh from the model x2* on the molecule's GFN2-xTB force field; for 1 of them the step's error is not measured for that kind of mode, and no bar is printed), the harmonic position ω for the other 6, each with its reason; ω stands beside every ν; the licence (decision 65) is on the harmonic position ω against the DFT proxy (ωB97X); it says nothing about the anharmonic position ν; no licence is claimed for ν

cautions.nu_error: the bar beside a step is the step's error alone — the rms of Δ_anh against its B3LYP VPT2 label — and not the error of ν: ν carries ω's error too, the harmonic position's error against the DFT proxy (ωB97X), which is what the licence is about; neither of the two is an error against experiment
cautions.targets: the bars rest on 2 target molecules, coronene and tetracene, both hydrocarbons — target modes: CH-oop 22, other 23, ring-ip 56, CH-stretch 20; the step's rms per molecule, coronene / tetracene, in cm⁻¹: CH-oop 11.91 / 4.55; other 5.69 / 1.09; ring-ip 4.25 / 2.35; CH-stretch 6.92 / 5.67; coronene carries the larger error in every family. They are the best numbers there are and they are thin: nothing here says the step helps a molecule unlike the targets, and a bar is a family's rms, not a prediction interval for one band. The bars were measured with one stored force field per molecule; between two GFN2-xTB force fields of the same molecule the step itself also varies, by 1.7 cm⁻¹ on a C–H stretch pair in the one case measured (benzene, 17 Nov 2026), and the bars do not contain that
cautions.seen: the anharmonic model x2* has not seen this molecule: it is neither in its training table (37 molecules) nor a target

field.software: GFN2-xTB: the minimum by xtb, the Hessians by dxtb (central differences of its forces) at ±0.10 along every mode, dpir.qff; GVPT2 by probes/gvpt2_labels.py with pyVPT2's polyad solver (probes/xtb_field_for_step.sh)

positions.drawn: curves are drawn at the harmonic positions ω, so that the network, B3LYP and ωB97X are compared like with like; the certificate lists each band's anharmonic estimate ν beside its ω

deliveries.delivery: first: harmonic, the anharmonic step is running

provenance.note: each band is printed at its best estimate — the anharmonic position ν = ω + Δ_anh for 27 of 33 bands (Δ_anh from the model x2* on the molecule's GFN2-xTB force field; for 1 of them the step's error is not measured for that kind of mode, and no bar is printed), the harmonic position ω for the other 6, each with its reason; ω stands beside every ν; the licence (decision 65) is on the harmonic position ω against the DFT proxy (ωB97X); it says nothing about the anharmonic position ν; no licence is claimed for ν

statement: benzonitrile: the infrared spectrum of ΔH-network v1.4 (3 seeds) — B3LYP/6-31G* corrected toward ωB97X/6-31G*. The spectrum is made by the release networks of version 1.4, trained on the 1132 labelled entries of their training pool, hold-outs (a) and (b) included: each of the 3 networks is fitted on a random 85 % of the molecules and stopped on the other 15 %, a different 15 % per seed, so not every molecule is fitted by every network (with 3 networks about 0.15³ ≈ 0.3 % by none). Its error bars were measured on the measurement networks of the same version — the same recipe trained without the hold-out molecules — on molecules those networks never saw; the release networks themselves have seen the molecules of hold-outs (a) and (b), so they have no held-out error of their own. The error stated is the measurement networks' error of the corrected band positions of the seed-mean correction; the 0 of 33 bands are licensed: the version's harmonic positions ω are licensed for ring-ip, CH-stretch, CH-oop, other (decision 65), and for this molecule that licence is withheld — the molecule has a linear group (an angle near 180°, as in a nitrile or an alkyne), and the measured spread under a rotation, a mirror image or another xyz listing of the atoms for molecules with one (11.20 cm⁻¹, from the release's invariance record) exceeds the licence line of 3 cm⁻¹, so the network's correction for this molecule is not licensed; the corrected positions are still printed — each band marked; at the coupled-cluster level not measured for this network version: the coupled-cluster reads (T3) were made on an earlier network (chain 34). The scaled B3LYP spectrum is shown as the baseline only. This molecule and the ΔH network: in the release networks' training data: the error bars are not an out-of-sample error for this molecule; expect it to be smaller.
